scene: A single plain wooden chair with four legs, a flat seat and an upright back, seen three-quarter from the front on the floor line against a plain wall. It is narrow: the seat is about the width of one person's hips. No cushion, no arms.
must: a narrow seat with four legs and an upright back, wide enough for one person.
avoid: a wide seat with a cushioned back and arms for several people (bank); a stool with no back (not the card); an armchair with thick padding (bank); a folding deckchair (not the card).
contrast: Pair with bank. The only difference is the seat: narrow and hard with an upright back here, wide and padded for several people there.
example_nl: Er staat een stoel bij de tafel.
example_en: There is a chair by the table.
alt: Een smal houten zitje met vier poten en een rechte rugleuning staat tegen een lege muur.

scene: A wide padded sofa with a soft cushioned seat, a tall padded back and two rounded arms, seen three-quarter from the front on the floor line against a plain wall. It is more than three times as wide as a chair, with three seat cushions.
must: a wide padded seat with arms and three seat cushions.
avoid: a single narrow wooden chair (stoel); a bench with no padding in a park (not the card); a bed with a pillow (not the card); an armchair for one person (stoel).
contrast: Pair with stoel. The only difference is the seat: wide and padded for several people here, narrow and hard for one person there.
example_nl: De kat slaapt op de bank.
example_en: The cat sleeps on the sofa.
alt: Een brede, zachte zitplaats met drie kussens en twee gebogen armleuningen staat tegen een lege muur.

scene: A low lace-up shoe seen side-on, standing on the ground line against a plain wall, with a rounded toe, a flat sole, three pairs of lace holes and a simple knot, and a top opening that stops just above the ankle bone. About twice as long as a hand.
must: a low shoe whose opening stops at the ankle.
avoid: a tall boot reaching the knee (laars); a sandal with open straps (not the card); a slipper with no laces (not the card); a sock (not the card).
contrast: Pair with laars. The only difference is the height: the shaft stops at the ankle here, and reaches the knee there.
example_en: My shoe is too small.
alt: Een laag voorwerp voor de voet met een veter, een platte zool en een opening bij de enkel.

scene: A tall boot seen side-on, standing on the ground line against a plain wall, with a rounded toe, a flat sole, a slightly raised heel and a smooth tall shaft that reaches as high as an adult's knee, no laces and a short pull-tab at the top.
must: a smooth tall shaft reaching up to the knee.
avoid: a low shoe that stops at the ankle (schoen); a sock pulled up to the knee (not the card); a sandal (not the card); a slipper (not the card).
contrast: Pair with schoen. The only difference is the height: a shaft up to the knee here, an opening at the ankle there.
example_nl: Het is nat, dus ik trek mijn laarzen aan.
example_en: It is wet, so I put on my boots.
alt: Een hoog voorwerp voor de voet met een gladde pijp die tot de knie reikt en een klein lusje boven.

scene: A small cat seen side-on, whole figure, standing on the ground line against a plain wall, with two pointed triangular ears, round face with whiskers, a slim body and a long tail curved upward. About the size of two shoeboxes, no collar.
must: pointed ears, whiskers and a long upright tail on a small slim animal.
avoid: a dog with a long snout and floppy ears (hond); a tiger with stripes (not the card); a rabbit with long upright ears (not the card); a fox with a bushy tail (not the card).
contrast: Pair with hond. The only difference is the animal: pointed ears, whiskers and a slim body here, a long snout and floppy ears there.
example_nl: De kat drinkt melk uit een kom.
example_en: The cat drinks milk from a bowl.
alt: Een klein dier met spitse oren, lange snorharen en een gebogen staart staat op de grond.

scene: A medium dog seen side-on, whole figure, standing on the ground line against a plain wall, with a long snout, two floppy folded ears, a sturdy body and a thick tail hanging down or slightly raised. Bigger than the cat would be; no collar, no lead.
must: a long snout with floppy ears on a sturdy four-legged animal.
avoid: a cat with pointed ears and whiskers (kat); a wolf with upright ears (not the card); a pig with a flat snout (not the card); a sheep with a woolly coat (not the card).
contrast: Pair with kat. The only difference is the animal: a long snout and floppy ears here, pointed ears and whiskers there.
example_en: My dog wants to play outside.
alt: Een stevig dier met een lange snuit en slappe oren staat op vier poten.

scene: A cow seen side-on, whole figure, standing on the ground line in front of a plain fence, with two short curved horns, large patches on the body, a heavy pendulous udder under the belly and a long thin tail with a tuft. About as long as two pigs.
must: two short curved horns and a heavy udder under the belly.
avoid: a sheep with a woolly coat and no horns (schaap); a pig with a curly tail and flat snout (varken); a horse with a mane (not the card); a goat with a beard (not the card).
contrast: Pair with schaap and varken. The only difference is the animal: horns and an udder here, a woolly coat or a flat snout with a curly tail there.
example_nl: De koe staat in de wei.
example_en: The cow stands in the meadow.
alt: Een groot dier met twee korte hoorns en een zware zak onder de buik staat voor een hek.

scene: A sheep seen side-on, whole figure, standing on the ground line in front of a plain fence, with a thick curly woolly coat covering the body, a small dark face, thin legs and a short tail. About half the size of a cow, no horns, no udder.
must: a thick curly woolly coat on a small body.
avoid: a cow with horns and an udder (koe); a pig with a curly tail and flat snout (varken); a goat with a beard (not the card); a cloud (not the card).
contrast: Pair with koe and varken. The only difference is the animal: a thick woolly coat here, horns and an udder or a bare skin with a curly tail there.
example_en: The sheep eats grass.
alt: Een klein dier met een dikke krullende vacht en dunne pootjes staat voor een hek.

scene: A pig seen side-on, whole figure, standing on the ground line in front of a plain fence, with a round bare body, a flat snout with two nostrils, small floppy ears, short legs with split hooves and a short curly tail. No horns, no coat, no udder.
must: a flat snout with two nostrils and a short curly tail on a round body.
avoid: a cow with horns and an udder (koe); a sheep with a woolly coat (schaap); a dog with a long snout (not the card); a wild boar with tusks (not the card).
contrast: Pair with koe and schaap. The only difference is the animal: a flat snout and a curly tail here, horns, an udder or a woolly coat there.
example_nl: Het varken ligt in de modder.
example_en: The pig lies in the mud.
alt: Een rond dier met een platte neus, korte pootjes en een krulstaartje staat voor een hek.

scene: One round apple on the table line, seen side-on, with a gentle dip at the top where a short stalk grows with one leaf, a smooth skin and a slightly flat base. Its width is about equal to its height.
must: a round shape with a dip at the top and a short stalk.
avoid: a pear with a narrow neck and a wide base (peer); a tomato with a star-shaped top (not the card); an orange with a rough skin (not the card); a peach (not the card).
contrast: Pair with peer. The only difference is the shape: round and equal in width and height here, narrow at the top and wide at the base there.
example_nl: Ik eet elke dag een appel.
example_en: I eat an apple every day.
alt: Een ronde vrucht met een kuiltje bovenaan, een kort steeltje en één blaadje ligt op een tafel.

scene: One pear on the table line, seen side-on, with a narrow neck at the top where a short stalk grows with one leaf, a wide rounded base, a smooth skin and a gentle curve between them. It is clearly taller than it is wide.
must: a narrow neck above a wide round base.
avoid: a round apple (appel); a bell or a bulb (not the card); a gourd (not the card); a drop of water (not the card).
contrast: Pair with appel. The only difference is the shape: a narrow neck and a wide base here, equal width and height with a round dip there.
example_nl: De peer is nog niet rijp.
example_en: The pear is not ripe yet.
alt: Een vrucht met een smal bovenstuk, een kort steeltje en een brede ronde onderkant ligt op een tafel.

scene: A wall seen from the front with one square window set at chest height above the ground line: a frame with four panes, a sill beneath it and plain glass lines. The wall below the window is solid down to the ground.
must: a square pane in a frame with solid wall beneath it down to the ground.
avoid: a tall door reaching the ground (deur); a hole in the wall with no frame (not the card); a mirror on a wall (not the card); a picture frame (not the card).
contrast: Pair with deur. The only difference is the opening: a square pane with wall below it here, a tall panel reaching the ground there.
example_en: May the window be open?
alt: Een muur met een vierkante opening in een kozijn, met een vensterbank eronder.

scene: A wall seen from the front with one tall plain door reaching down to the ground line: a rectangular panel with a handle at hip height, hinges on one side and a small step at its foot. The wall around it is plain.
must: a tall panel reaching the ground with a handle at hip height.
avoid: a window above the ground with a sill (raam); a gate in a fence (not the card); a garage door with horizontal sections (not the card); an archway with no panel (not the card).
contrast: Pair with raam. The only difference is the opening: a tall panel reaching the ground with a handle here, a square pane above the ground there.
example_en: Close the door, please.
alt: Een hoge plaat in de muur reikt tot de grond en heeft een klink op heuphoogte.

scene: A closed hardcover book lying flat on a table line, seen three-quarter from above, thick with a stiff cover, a visible spine and about forty page edges visible at the side. The cover is plain with no marks and no title.
must: a thick closed block with a stiff cover and a spine.
avoid: a wide thin folded newspaper (krant); a notebook with a spiral (not the card); a single sheet of paper (not the card); a tablet or phone (not the card).
contrast: Pair with krant. The only difference is the object: a thick stiff-covered block here, wide loose folded sheets with no spine there.
example_en: This book is very thick.
alt: Een dik, gesloten pakket met een harde kaft en een rug ligt plat op een tafel.

scene: A wide thin newspaper lying flat on a table line, seen from above, four loose folded sheets with one fold down the middle, no stiff cover and no spine. The top sheet is greeked: a wide empty bar, an empty box and three columns of short bold strokes, no letter shapes.
must: wide loose folded sheets with a central fold and columns of strokes.
avoid: a thick hardcover with a spine (boek); a magazine with a glossy cover (not the card); a single sheet of paper (not the card); a letter in an envelope (not the card).
contrast: Pair with boek. The only difference is the object: wide loose folded sheets here, a thick stiff-covered block there.
example_nl: Mijn vader leest elke dag de krant.
example_en: My father reads the newspaper every day.
alt: Een brede stapel losse, dubbelgevouwen vellen met kolommen streepjes ligt plat op een tafel.

scene: One adult hand drawn alone, seen from the side at a slight angle, palm down, resting flat on the same surface line as the foot against a plain background. Four fingers lie side by side with the thumb in front of them, and a wrist at the edge; no ring.
must: four long fingers and a thumb lying flat on the surface.
avoid: a foot with five short toes and a heel (voet); a glove (not the card); a paw (not the card); a fist with no fingers visible (not the card).
contrast: Pair with voet. The only difference is the body part: four long fingers and a thumb here, short toes and a heel there.
example_en: Give me your hand.
alt: Een open lichaamsdeel met vier lange vingers en een duim ligt plat op een vlak.

scene: One adult bare foot drawn alone, side view, flat on the same surface line as the hand against a plain background. Five short toes at the front in a slope, a high arch, a rounded heel at the back and an ankle at the edge, no sock, no shoe.
must: a heel, an arch and five short toes pointing forward on the ground.
avoid: a hand with long fingers (hand); a shoe (schoen); a hoof (not the card); a paw (not the card).
contrast: Pair with hand. The only difference is the body part: a heel and short toes on the ground here, four long fingers and a thumb lying flat there.
example_en: My foot hurts.
alt: Een bloot lichaamsdeel met een hiel en vijf korte tenen staat plat op de grond.

scene: An adult head seen three-quarter from the front, drawn in plain cobalt line with a neutral mouth and no hair detail, so one ear shows at the side. A small ring circles the eye: an almond shape with an eyelid, a round iris, a dark pupil and lashes, drawn at normal size.
must: an almond-shaped eye with iris, pupil and lashes inside the ring.
avoid: a nose ringed instead (neus); an ear ringed instead (oor); a closed eye shown as a line (not the card); a cartoon spiral eye (not the card).
contrast: Pair with oor and neus. The only difference is the ringed part: an almond eye with a round iris here, a curved ear or a nose there.
example_nl: Ik heb pijn in mijn oog.
example_en: I have a pain in my eye.
alt: Een hoofd schuin van voren, met een cirkel om een amandelvormig onderdeel met een ronde kring erin.

scene: An adult head seen three-quarter from the front, drawn in plain cobalt line with a neutral mouth and no hair detail, so one ear shows at the side. A small ring circles the ear on the side of the head: a curved rim, an inner fold and a rounded lobe, drawn at normal size.
must: a curved ear with a rim, a fold and a lobe at the side of the head.
avoid: an eye ringed instead (oog); a nose ringed instead (neus); an ear with a hearing aid (not the card); a cat ear (not the card).
contrast: Pair with oog and neus. The only difference is the ringed part: a curved ear at the side of the head here, an eye or a nose in the middle there.
example_en: My ear hurts.
alt: Een hoofd schuin van voren, met een cirkel om een gebogen rand aan de zijkant van het hoofd.

scene: An adult head seen three-quarter from the front, drawn in plain cobalt line with a neutral mouth and no hair detail, so one ear shows at the side. A small ring circles the nose: a bridge line, a rounded tip and two nostrils, drawn at normal size.
must: a bridge line, a rounded tip and two nostrils in the middle of the face.
avoid: an eye ringed instead (oog); an ear ringed instead (oor); a clown nose (not the card); a snout (not the card).
contrast: Pair with oog and oor. The only difference is the ringed part: a nose with two nostrils in the middle here, an eye or an ear there.
example_en: My nose is cold.
alt: Een hoofd schuin van voren, met een cirkel om een uitstekend deel in het midden met twee gaatjes.

scene: One adult figure seen from the front in plain shirt and shorts, standing on the ground line against a plain wall, with the right arm held straight out sideways at shoulder height, hand open. A small bracket line along the arm marks it; both legs stay straight together.
must: one arm held straight out sideways with a bracket line along it.
avoid: a raised leg in a step (been); a hand alone (not the card); a leg held out sideways (been); a wing (not the card).
contrast: Pair with been. The only difference is the limb: an arm out sideways at shoulder height here, a leg lifted in a step there.
example_en: She breaks her arm.
alt: Een persoon in een kort broekje houdt één lichaamsdeel recht naar opzij op schouderhoogte.

scene: One adult figure seen from the front in plain shirt and shorts, standing on the ground line against a plain wall, with the right leg lifted forward in a step with the knee bent, foot off the ground. A small bracket line along the leg marks it; both arms hang down.
must: one leg lifted in a step with a bracket line along it.
avoid: an arm held out sideways (arm); a foot alone (voet); a table leg or chair leg (not the card); a leg in a trouser leg (not the card).
contrast: Pair with arm. The only difference is the limb: a leg lifted in a step here, an arm held out sideways there.
example_en: He has a broken leg.
alt: Een persoon in een kort broekje heeft één onderdeel opgetild en vooruit gezet, zoals bij een stap.

scene: One tall tree with a thick straight trunk, bark lines and a wide round crown of many leaves, standing on the ground line under plain sky. No person, no animal and no other object beside it. The boom-een and boom-meer cards reuse this drawing.
must: a tall trunk with a wide round crown.
avoid: a flower on a thin stem (bloem); a single leaf (blad); a bush with no trunk (not the card); a bare dead branch (not the card).
contrast: Pair with bloem and blad. The only difference is the plant part: a whole tall tree here, one flower or one leaf there.
example_nl: Er staat een grote boom in de tuin.
example_en: There is a big tree in the garden.
alt: Een hoge stam met een brede ronde top staat op de grond.

scene: One flower on a single thin stem with two leaves, standing on the ground line under plain sky, with a round centre and eight rounded petals around it. No coin, no person and no other object beside it.
must: one round-centred flower with eight petals on a thin stem.
avoid: a tall tree with a trunk (boom); a single leaf on its own (blad); a bunch of flowers tied together (bos-bos); a cactus (not the card).
contrast: Pair with boom and blad. The only difference is the plant part: a small flower head on a thin stem here, a big trunk with a crown or one flat leaf there.
example_nl: Ik koop een bloem voor mijn moeder.
example_en: I buy a flower for my mother.
alt: Een dunne stengel met een ronde kop en acht ronde slippen eromheen.

scene: One single leaf lying on the ground line under plain sky, seen from slightly above, with a stalk at one end, a pointed oval shape, a central vein and four side veins on each side. No coin and no other object beside it. The blad-een and blad-meer cards reuse this drawing.
must: a flat pointed oval with a central vein and a short stalk.
avoid: a tree with a trunk (boom); a flower with petals (bloem); a feather (not the card); a page of paper (not the card).
contrast: Pair with boom and bloem. The only difference is the plant part: one flat leaf with veins here, a whole tree or one flower head there.
example_nl: Het blad is van de boom gevallen.
example_en: The leaf has fallen from the tree.
alt: Eén plat, spits ovaal vlak met een steeltje en lijntjes die zich vertakken.

scene: A wide field with about twenty trees of different heights growing close together in three rows, with a small path running through them and a plain sky above. No person, no animals, and the trees fill the whole width of the picture.
must: many trees growing close together across the whole width.
avoid: one tree alone (boom); a bunch of flowers held in a hand (bos-bos); a park with a bench and a pond (not the card); an orchard with rows of apples (not the card).
contrast: Pair with bos-bos. The only difference is the thing: many trees across a wide field here, a small bunch of flowers held in one hand there.
example_en: We walk through the forest.
alt: Heel veel bomen staan dicht bij elkaar, met een smal pad ertussen.

scene: One hand holding a bunch of about ten flowers tied with a single ribbon at the stems, the flower heads fanned out at the top and the stems hanging below the fist, against plain sky. The bunch is no bigger than the hand's forearm.
must: a hand holding a tied bunch of flowers by the stems.
avoid: a forest of many trees (bos-woud); one flower in a vase (bloem); a vase full of flowers (not the card); a wreath (not the card).
contrast: Pair with bos-woud. The only difference is the thing: a small tied bunch held in one hand here, many trees across a wide field there.
example_nl: Ik geef haar een bos bloemen.
example_en: I give her a bunch of flowers.
alt: Een hand houdt een bundel stelen met bloemhoofden bovenaan vast, onderaan met een lint samengebonden.

scene: A plain sky strip above a flat horizon line with one large round sun, about as wide as a thumb at arm's length, and eleven straight rays of equal length evenly spaced around it. Nothing else in the sky.
must: a round disc with straight rays all around it.
avoid: a crescent shape (maan); a small five-pointed star (ster); a lamp with rays (not the card); a cloud covering part of the disc (not the card).
contrast: Pair with maan and ster. The only difference is the shape in the sky: a round disc with rays here, a crescent or a small pointed star there.
example_en: The sun is shining today.
alt: Een grote ronde schijf boven de horizon met rondom rechte stralen.

scene: A plain sky strip above a flat horizon line with one large crescent moon, thin on the left and thick on the right, with a smooth inner curve and two sharp tips. No rays, no face and nothing else in the sky.
must: a thick crescent with two sharp tips and no rays.
avoid: a round disc with rays (zon); a small pointed star (ster); a banana (not the card); a cloud (not the card).
contrast: Pair with zon and ster. The only difference is the shape in the sky: a crescent with sharp tips here, a round disc with rays or a small pointed star there.
example_nl: De maan staat boven het huis.
example_en: The moon is above the house.
alt: Een grote gebogen sikkel boven de horizon, met twee scherpe punten en geen stralen.

scene: A plain sky strip above a flat horizon line with one small five-pointed star, drawn with straight edges, no rays and no face, about a thumb's width at arm's length, set high above the horizon. Nothing else in the sky.
must: a small five-pointed shape with straight edges.
avoid: a round disc with rays (zon); a crescent (maan); a snowflake (not the card); a starfish (not the card).
contrast: Pair with zon and maan. The only difference is the shape in the sky: a small five-pointed shape here, a large round disc or a crescent there.
example_nl: Ik zie een ster aan de hemel.
example_en: I see a star in the sky.
alt: Een klein vijfpuntig figuurtje hoog boven de horizon.

scene: A cut-away living room seen from the front with a sofa with three cushions against the back wall, a low table in front of it, a window in the back wall and a rug on the floor. No cooker, no sink, no bed.
must: a sofa and a low table in a plain room.
avoid: a cooker and a sink (keuken); a bed and a wardrobe (not the card); a bathroom with a bath (not the card); an empty box room (not the card).
contrast: Pair with keuken. The only difference is the furniture: a sofa and a low table here, a cooker and a sink there.
example_en: We are sitting in the living room.
alt: Een doorsnede van een vertrek met een lange zachte zitplaats, een lage tafel en een raam.

scene: A cut-away room seen from the front with a cooker with four rings on one side, a sink with a tap beneath the back window, a counter with a pan on it and one cupboard above. No sofa, no low table.
must: a cooker with four rings and a sink in a plain room.
avoid: a sofa and a low table (kamer); a dining table with chairs (not the card); a bathroom basin and toilet (not the card); a shop counter (not the card).
contrast: Pair with kamer. The only difference is the furniture: a cooker and a sink here, a sofa and a low table there.
example_nl: Mijn moeder kookt in de keuken.
example_en: My mother is cooking in the kitchen.
alt: Een doorsnede van een vertrek met een fornuis met vier pitten, een gootsteen en een pan.

scene: A small open rowing boat seen side-on on a flat wavy water line, a curved hull with a pointed bow, two thin oars sticking out and one bench inside, about as long as three people lying down. No sails, no flag.
must: a small open hull with oars and a bench on wavy water.
avoid: a large ship with a tall hull and decks (schip); a canoe with a paddler (not the card); a floating log (not the card); a surfboard (not the card).
contrast: Pair with schip. The only difference is the vessel: a small open hull with oars here, a huge tall hull with decks there.
example_nl: Wij varen met een kleine boot.
example_en: We sail in a small boat.
alt: Een klein open vaartuig met twee lange roeiriemen drijft op golvend water.

scene: A large ship seen side-on on a flat wavy water line, a tall hull with two decks of portholes, a tall funnel and a bridge on top, about ten times as long as a rowing boat would be. No flag, no name. The schip-een and schip-meer cards reuse this drawing.
must: a tall hull with decks, portholes and a funnel on wavy water.
avoid: a small open boat with oars (boot); a floating dock (not the card); a lighthouse (not the card); a submarine (not the card).
contrast: Pair with boot. The only difference is the vessel: a huge tall hull with decks and a funnel here, a small open hull with oars there.
example_en: The ship is sailing to England.
alt: Een enorm vaartuig met een hoge romp, twee rijen ronde raampjes en een schoorsteen drijft op golvend water.

scene: One child in plain shirt and shorts, whole-figure, front view, arms at the sides, standing in the middle of the picture on a flat ground line against a plain wall. Child proportions: the head is one quarter of the body height, short limbs, a round face. Empty ground on both sides.
must: one single small figure with empty ground on both sides.
avoid: three children in a row (kind-meer); a child with a parent (not the card); a baby on the floor (not the card); an adult (not the card).
contrast: Pair with kind-meer. The only difference is the number: one child here, three identical children side by side there.
example_nl: Het kind speelt in de tuin.
example_en: The child is playing in the garden.
alt: Een klein persoon in een kort broekje staat alleen midden op de vlakte.

scene: Three identical children in plain shirt and shorts, whole-figure, front view, arms at the sides, evenly spaced side by side on one flat ground line against a plain wall, each with child proportions (head one quarter of body height, short limbs) and the same size as the single child.
must: three identical small figures separated by gaps.
avoid: one child alone (kind-een); two children (not the card); a crowd of many (not the card); a child with a parent (not the card).
contrast: Pair with kind-een. The only difference is the number: three identical children side by side here, one child alone there.
example_en: The children eat an apple.
alt: Drie gelijke kleine personen staan naast elkaar met ruimte ertussen.

scene: The same drawing as the schip card: one large ship seen side-on on a flat wavy water line, a tall hull with two decks of portholes, a tall funnel and a bridge on top, in the middle of the picture with empty water on both sides. No flag, no name.
must: one single ship with empty water on both sides.
avoid: three ships in a row (schip-meer); a small rowing boat (boot); a harbour full of ships (not the card); a ship with sails (not the card).
contrast: Pair with schip-meer. The only difference is the number: one ship here, three identical ships side by side there.
example_en: The ship is very big.
alt: Een enkel groot vaartuig met een hoge romp en een schoorsteen drijft alleen op golvend water.

scene: Three copies of the schip drawing: identical large ships seen side-on on one flat wavy water line, each with a tall hull, two decks of portholes, a tall funnel and a bridge, evenly spaced with gaps of empty water between them, each the same size as the single ship.
must: three identical ships separated by gaps.
avoid: one ship alone (schip-een); a row of small boats (boot); two ships (not the card); ships overlapping in a harbour (not the card).
contrast: Pair with schip-een. The only difference is the number: three identical ships side by side here, one ship alone there.
example_nl: In de haven liggen veel schepen.
example_en: There are many ships in the harbour.
alt: Drie gelijke grote vaartuigen met hoge rompen drijven naast elkaar met ruimte ertussen.

scene: One bare adult leg seen side-on from the hip down, a foot flat on the ground line, a visible knee, no shoe and no clothing, standing alone in the middle of the picture with empty ground on both sides.
must: a single leg with empty ground on both sides.
avoid: two legs side by side (been-meer); a leg in a trouser leg (not the card); a table leg (not the card); an arm (arm).
contrast: Pair with been-meer. The only difference is the number: one leg here, two identical legs standing side by side there.
example_en: My leg is tired.
alt: Een enkel lichaamsdeel met een knie en een platte voet staat alleen op de grond.

scene: Two identical bare adult legs seen side-on from the hip down, standing side by side a hand's width apart on one ground line, each with a flat foot and a visible knee, no shoe, no clothing, each the same size as the single leg.
must: two identical legs standing side by side.
avoid: one leg alone (been-een); three legs (not the card); legs crossed at the ankle (not the card); two arms (arm).
contrast: Pair with been-een. The only difference is the number: two identical legs side by side here, one leg alone there.
example_en: My legs are very tired.
alt: Twee gelijke lichaamsdelen met knieën en platte voeten staan naast elkaar op de grond.

scene: The same drawing as the boom card: one tall tree with a thick straight trunk, bark lines and a wide round crown, standing in the middle of the picture on a flat ground line under plain sky, with empty ground on both sides.
must: one single tree with empty ground on both sides.
avoid: three trees in a row (boom-meer); a forest (bos-woud); a bush (not the card); a flower (bloem).
contrast: Pair with boom-meer. The only difference is the number: one tree here, three identical trees side by side there.
example_en: The tree is very big.
alt: Een enkele stam met een ronde top staat alleen op een vlakke grond.

scene: Three copies of the boom drawing: identical tall trees with thick straight trunks, bark lines and wide round crowns, evenly spaced side by side with gaps of empty ground on one flat ground line under plain sky, each the same size as the single tree.
must: three identical trees separated by gaps.
avoid: one tree alone (boom-een); a dense forest (bos-woud); two trees (not the card); a row of bushes (not the card).
contrast: Pair with boom-een. The only difference is the number: three identical trees side by side here, one tree alone there.
example_en: The trees lose their leaves.
alt: Drie gelijke stammen met ronde toppen staan naast elkaar met ruimte ertussen.
